verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own isolated execution environment, Databricks Sandbox, where agents run the code they write with a persistent home directory. Free Edition is also a separate no-cost workspace for experimenting with data and AI. However, nothing in the evidence says the Sandbox is walled off from production tables, or that you can provision test or cloned data for safe testing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox runs cannot read/write production data, dev/test vs prod environment separation or data cloning for testing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
